items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: They had Al Moore on trombone, Cyril Dill on drums, and a piano man I think his name was Greenwald. And Hank was on trumpet and I was on sax and clarinet.

ctx.x: Does Hank Bellis ever sit in?

Oh he did some time back and he had a slight hemorrhage or something so he quit. In fact I think he sold his horn Sunday night to Johnny Newroth, his nephew. Oh yeah. I think he's always one of the...well he played a fine horn. I played with Hank over at the Casino Royale, that's Al Hurts. I used to call it the Casino Royale and I think Stormy was there at the time. And they had a Hawaiian band on one side and an hour band had the flow show and the band on the other side. They had Al Moore on trombone, Cyril Dill…
Yeah, names I just never heard of. I never heard of Speck Reagan that I know of. He's from New Orleans.
